geometry_analysis.surface_profile: Convex reinforcement, but the profile is visually disrupted by heavy surface scaling and pits.

visual_anomalies.visual_description: Multiple deep, dark cavities visible. Most notably: a severe cluster of 3-4 large holes at the End (Right), scattered deep holes along the Body (Middle), and smaller pores at the Start (Left).
visual_anomalies.visual_severity: High; porosity indicates trapped gas throughout the process

visual_anomalies.visual_description: A wide, continuous band of rust-brown, glassy material covering the upper half of the weld face along the entire length. This suggests heavy deoxidation product accumulation.
Steep toe angles are visible, particularly along the bottom edge where the metal is exposed.

surface_state.discoloration: Significant oxidation tones (rust/brown) mixed with the grey weld metal
